Package me.manossef.api.alexandria.commands

Class TabCompletions

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.manossef.api.alexandria.commands.TabCompletions
  • public final class TabCompletions
extends java.lang.Object
    Contains methods for creating tab completers for plugin commands. Arguments tab completed by any completers created by these methods are removed when the argument typed in the chat in that position isn't a beginning substring to those arguments.

    If null is passed into any of these methods' parameters, a NullPointerException will be thrown.
